title: stale test assertions: reader plaintext_password_in_auth_users_is_validation_error
description: reader/src/config.rs line 2324 asserts msg.contains("auth.users[0].password") but the error emitted by validate() after commit 6d06d8e is "auth.users['alice']: password is not a valid bcrypt hash (cost must be 4–31)" — neither 'auth.users[0].password' nor 'plaintext' appears in that string. Both assertions on lines 2324 and 2328 will fail. The test was not updated when the error message was changed.
